verdict.rationale: Org-wide policy enforcement is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only per-user security settings: TouchID/PIN app protection, disabling future installations on one's own account, and backup passwords. Nothing documents an admin console or any way for an IT admin to require app lock, restrict export, or mandate strong master credentials across members' apps.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
